C1030.title: Employee Lending WeChat Account Leads to 168,000 Yuan Bank Card Theft
C1030.summary: In August 2017, a man surnamed Li in Hubei lent his WeChat account, which was linked to his bank card, to his dormitory colleague surnamed He to log into a game. He discovered the linked bank card and used the account to transfer funds to himself, stealing over 168,000 yuan within a month. He was prosecuted for larceny.
